architectural-decision-records.why: records the pre-push hook decision and its trust boundary
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR 0048: a node pre-push hook runs the offline gates locally as a pre-flight, installed by esk-genesis, with CI as the authoritative backstop and the limits stated
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

verifiable-quality-gates.why: the hook ships a discrimination test that fails if it stops blocking
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added the hook template + test/pre-push-hook.test.mjs (passes when gates pass, blocks when any offline gate fails, skips an absent gate) and a genesis install+idempotency test; confirmed end-to-end that a tampered gate is blocked
quotes: replace each check with a no-op and require its test to fail

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: the change adds executable code, so the test level is explicit
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: a fixture-driven test runs the real hook against stub gates; the esk-genesis test covers installation; the right level for a local hook, no integration surface beyond that
quotes: Fast, isolated tests for logic; a smaller number of integration tests for the seams

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: coupling fires on the added code; the behavior is committed as Gherkin
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: implements the sync-drift local pre-push hook whose bypass does not escape CI, with a discrimination test
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment. Every time this

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: esk-genesis writes an executable hook and sets git config in a target repo
owasp-secure-coding-bdd.what: the hook install reuses the contained write path and best-effort chmod/config; it writes only the .githooks/pre-push file and sets core.hooksPath, never runs untrusted input, and the hook runs only local gate scripts already in the repo
quotes: For the change in front of you, look up the matching sheet in the catalog below

skeptical-audit.why: the ADR states the limits rather than overclaiming
skeptical-audit.what: documented that the hook is a convenience not the authority, that hooks are per-clone so core.hooksPath must be set per clone, that provenance is CI-only, and that the exec bit is best-effort
quotes: content hash, a query, a version/commit SHA, or a URL + retrieval date;

judge-arch.why: reviewed in fresh context before the PR
judge-arch.what: will run a fresh-context judge-arch review over the hook template, the esk-genesis install change, the tests, and the ADR before opening the PR
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all

release-deployment-safety.why: a local developer hook; nothing deployed, migrated, or released

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: a CI/dev tooling hook; no system, data, or resilience architecture change

pattern-selector.why: no design pattern selected; a run-the-gates loop

sre-operational-readiness.why: no service, SLI/SLO, or alerting change

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no personal data, retention, or migration

arch-encode.why: planned machinery, not a rule encoded from a newly-caught mistake
